title: Three-Scene Story · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Three-Scene Story · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on three everyday settings, such as a room, a park and a shop. The lead tells a short story that visits the settings in the agreed order. The story visits all three settings in order and has an ending. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Three-Scene Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The story visits all three settings in order and has an ending.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The story visits all three settings in order and has an ending.
